aaa_enabled.summary: Configure SAML Single Sign-On (SSO) in the ZPA Admin Portal.
aaa_enabled.notes: Go to ZPA Admin Portal > Administration > IdP Configuration to set up SAML authentication.

secure_vty_transport.summary: ZPA portal strictly enforces secure HTTPS administration connections.
secure_vty_transport.notes: HTTP and legacy cleartext console connections are not supported in ZPA.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Configure session timeout in Client Sessions.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Go to ZPA Admin Portal > Configuration > Client Sessions > Administrator Session Timeout.

enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Local user databases in ZPA automatically hash password credentials.

no_default_snmp_community.notes: Zscaler cloud endpoints do not expose traditional SNMP agent access.

http_server_disabled.notes: HTTP administrative connections are not supported by ZPA Admin Portal.

ssh_version_2.notes: SSH management access is not supported on ZPA cloud consoles.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure Log Receivers for log forwarding.
logging_enabled.notes: Go to ZPA Admin Portal > Configuration > Log Receivers to configure log destinations.

management_acl.summary: Configure source IP restrictions for administrators.
management_acl.notes: Go to ZPA Admin Portal > Administration > Administrator Management to configure allowed IP access controls.

login_banner.notes: Configure SAML warning screen details in the ZPA portal.

password_min_length.notes: Go to ZPA Admin Portal > Administration > Administrator Management > Password Policy.

ntp_configured.summary: Time synchronization is managed automatically by Zscaler Cloud.
ntp_configured.notes: Zscaler cloud nodes synchronize time automatically with internal NTP servers.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Legacy SNMP read-write is not applicable to ZPA cloud instances.
